columns.validationmsg: "Amount Transferred must be a valid amount"
columns.name: amttransfered

table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	CashierShiftCode,
	OpenedOn,
	ClosedOn,
	OpenedBy,
	ShiftOwner,
	ShiftStatus,
	CashAccCode,
	OpeningBalance,
	TotalAmount=	ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CSC.Qty * CSC.Denomination) FROM  CashierShiftCashCount CSC WHERE CSC.CashierShiftCode=CashierShift.CashierShiftCode), 0),
	AmtTransfered,
	AmtTransferedTo,
	AmtTransferedOn,
	Remarks,
	RefNo,
	CashSales=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(S.InvTotal) FROM SaleLedger S WHERE S.Posted='Y' AND S.SaleCatCode = 3 AND S.CashierShiftCode=CashierShift.CashierShiftCode), 0),
	CreditSales=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(S.InvTotal - S.Amt - S.CashCharged) FROM SaleLedger S WHERE S.Posted='Y' AND S.SaleCatCode <> 3 AND S.CashierShiftCode=CashierShift.CashierShiftCode), 0),
	CashSR=ISNULL((SELECT a=SUM(a)
		FROM
			(SELECT a=SUM(S.InvTotal) FROM SRLedger S WHERE S.Posted='Y' AND S.SRCatCode = 8 AND S.CashierShiftCode=CashierShift.CashierShiftCode 
			UNION ALL
			SELECT a=SUM(S.InvTotal) FROM SRBufferLedger S WHERE S.Posted='Y' AND S.SRCatCode = 8 AND S.CashierShiftCode=CashierShift.CashierShiftCode) T
		), 0),
	CreditSR=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(S.InvTotal - S.CashCharged) FROM SRLedger S WHERE S.Posted='Y' AND S.SRCatCode <> 8 AND S.CashierShiftCode=CashierShift.CashierShiftCode), 0),
	CashService=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(S.InvTotal) FROM ServiceHeader S WHERE S.Posted='Y' AND S.ServiceCatCode = 10 AND S.CashierShiftCode=CashierShift.CashierShiftCode), 0),
	CreditService=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(S.InvTotal - S.CashCharged) FROM ServiceHeader S WHERE S.Posted='Y' AND S.ServiceCatCode <> 10 AND S.CashierShiftCode=CashierShift.CashierShiftCode), 0),
	CashServiceReturn=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(S.InvTotal) FROM ServiceRHeader S WHERE S.Posted='Y' AND S.ServiceRCatCode = 13 AND S.CashierShiftCode=CashierShift.CashierShiftCode), 0),
	CreditServiceReturn=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(S.InvTotal - S.CashCharged) FROM ServiceRHeader S WHERE S.Posted='Y' AND S.Posted='Y' AND S.ServiceRCatCode <> 13 AND S.CashierShiftCode=CashierShift.CashierShiftCode), 0),
	TotalReceipts=CASE ShiftStatus WHEN 'O' THEN ISNULL((SELECT SUM(GD.Debit) FROM GLDetail GD, GLHeader GL WHERE GL.Posted='Y' AND  GL.Date BETWEEN CashierShift.OpenedOn AND ISNULL(CashierShift.ClosedOn, GETDATE()) AND GL.GLVochCode = GD.GLVochCode AND GD.AccCode = CashierShift.CashAccCode), 0) ELSE ISNULL(TotalReceipts,0) END,
	TotalPayments=CASE ShiftStatus WHEN 'O' THEN ISNULL((SELECT SUM(GD.Credit) FROM GLDetail GD, GLHeader GL WHERE GL.Posted='Y' AND  GL.Date BETWEEN CashierShift.OpenedOn AND ISNULL(CashierShift.ClosedOn, GETDATE()) AND GL.GLVochCode = GD.GLVochCode AND GD.AccCode = CashierShift.CashAccCode), 0) ELSE ISNULL(TotalPayments,0) END,
	NetAmt= NetAmt,
	DiffAmt = DiffAmt,
	DiffTransferedTo
FROM 
	CashierShift
WHERE 
	CashierShiftCode=:ai_code

objects.name: compute_2
